mapper.select: SELECT SUM(sb2.actual_amount) FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE st2.project_id = ( SELECT st.project_id FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE sb.settle_id = #{settleId} ) AND sb2.type = #{type} AND sb2.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sb2.total_amount FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE st2.project_id = ( SELECT st.project_id FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE sb.settle_id = #{settleId} ) AND sb2.type = #{type} AND sb2.settle_id != #{settleId} AND sb2.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND sb2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (sb2.status != 'PENDING') DESC, sb2.settle_id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT sb.settle_id FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE st.project_id = ( SELECT st0.project_id FROM settlement_block sb0 JOIN block b0 ON b0.block_id = sb0.block_id JOIN step st0 ON st0.step_id = b0.step_id WHERE sb0.settle_id = #{settleId} ) AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sb.settle_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT version, status, deleted_at AS deletedAt, type, round_no AS roundNo, total_amount AS totalAmount, planned_amount AS plannedAmount, planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, planned_date AS plannedDate, tax_invoice_due_date AS taxInvoiceDueDate, trader_name AS traderName, bank_name AS bankName, account_number AS accountNumber, account_holder AS accountHolder FROM settlement_block WHERE settle_id = #{settleId} FOR UPDATE
